notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Added difficulty options.
Fixed issue where 'Make Demands' tutorial text was never showing for some users.

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Quality of Life Changes
notes.content:
Added post-battle dialogs to guide players on how to level up the characters.
 First attempt at making demands during negotiation now much more likey to succeed.
 Shuffled starting stage order.
 Tweaked one of the coffee shop stages to make it more immediatley rewarding when solving the puzzle, instead of having to rely on luck.
